svg.text: Power Virtual Agent integrated with Qualys APIs and
ServiceNow. Pulls hostname/IP from RITM emails and
returns vulnerability reports in ~1–1.5 min, 100% accurate.
Weekly Power Automate flow reconciling Qualys assets vs
ServiceNow CMDB. Flags 14 discrepancy types and emails
owner-wise Excel summaries to infra, cloud & network teams.
Automated reconnaissance for security assessments with a
web interface for domain/org recon and real-time
interception and spyware techniques, with structured
logging for behavioral analysis and incident simulation.
